# Synthetic company discovery sources

Offline test evidence only. The URLs below label fictional primary-source
snapshots, not real companies or pages. Do not browse them or claim live checks.
All snapshots were supplied on 2026-09-15. Discover only these employers; the
normal research budget is not a quota. No application or outreach is authorized.

New Widgets is not yet a candidate target or a queued/universe company.

## Repeat-run rule

The same sources contain no new signal on a second run. Existing evaluations,
including the rejected company, must not be duplicated or reopened as discoveries.
